|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Leia (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-103-Leia.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-leia-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Leia (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB1-103-Leia-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “While at opponent's Galactic Senate, Leia's game text may not be canceled and may lose 1 Force to place Leia and any character present out of play. During battle, may cancel game text of a leader of ability < 5 with Leia for remainder of turn.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 10). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Leia (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Leia (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads a rewritten text: her game text may not be canceled anywhere (not only at opponent's Galactic Senate), and “Once per battle at her location, may cancel game text of opponent's leader of ability < 5 present” for “During battle, may cancel game text of a leader of ability < 5 with Leia”: “Leia's game text may not be canceled. While at opponent's Galactic Senate, may lose 1 Force to place Leia and any character present out of play. Once per battle at her location, may cancel game text of opponent's leader of ability < 5 present for remainder of turn.”<ref name="cl-1210_103-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html Virtual Block 1 card list] at res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008201609/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html Internet Archive]
